question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**endeavour**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage mentions that scientific progress contributed to the formation of the modern world.
 
• The correct word should relate to effort, work, or attempt in science and research.
 
• **'Endeavour' (प्रयास****)** means an attempt or effort to achieve a goal, fitting perfectly in the context of scientific pursuits.
 
• Other options like 'shirk' (to avoid duty), 'slacken' (to loosen or slow down), and 'doodle' (to draw aimlessly) do not fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The Enlightenment, sometimes known as the ‘Age of Reason’, is described as the period of (1)________ scientific, political, and philosophical debate that characterised European culture (2) ________ the ‘long’ 18th century: from the late 17th century until the end of the Napoleonic Wars in 1815. This was an era of an enormous (3) ________ in thinking and reason, which historian Roy Porter describes as ‘decisive in the formation of modernity’. Centuries of custom and tradition were (4) ________ in favour of exploration, individuality, tolerance, and scientific 5. endeavour__, all of which contributed to the formation of the ‘modern world’.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Shirk (चुपके से बचना): **Means to avoid or neglect duty, which is inappropriate here.
 
• **Slacken (ढीला पड़ना):** Means to make or become less active or slow, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Doodle (आलस्य में या ध्यान हटाने के लिए कुछ बनाना): **Means to draw aimlessly, unrelated to scientific effort.
